Name: Disable unused Game DVR capture
Description: Stops background Game DVR capture while keeping Xbox Game Bar available for overlays and dependencies.
Purpose: Reduce unnecessary background capture activity without disabling the Game Bar component itself.
AuditNotes: HKCU-only registry change. Two DWORD values. No third-party executable. Previous values are snapshotted before apply and restored on rollback.

Name: Preserve required Game Bar components
Description: Keeps Game Bar components available when another application depends on them.

Name: Review unnecessary startup applications
Description: Creates a startup review recommendation instead of blindly disabling applications.

Name: Reduce background capture activity
Description: Targets background capture overhead while preserving overlays and recording tools the user selected.
Purpose: Reduce background activity without breaking gaming dependencies.

Name: Create optimization snapshot
Description: Records the state Farla needs before applying future changes.
